name: VEILPAD
description: The protocol token of VEILPAD, the agentic privacy superapp on COTI. One billion, minted once in the constructor, with no mint function afterwards. Stake it, or wrap it through VeilPortal for p.VEILPAD, its private twin.

supply.note: The treasury allocation exists to pay staking rewards. It cannot be topped up by minting, because nothing can mint.
